content.text:
This confirms the analysis: the `system.properties` file (loaded by `SystemProperties`) only contains build-time keys (`product-version`, `product-build`, `git-commit`, etc.) — it never contains `exist.home`, which is a runtime JVM system property set via `-Dexist.home`. So calling `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown")` was guaranteed to always return `"unknown"`.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: c342cbc05e44f776f0055b8182abbf4550a6c459

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** The fix commit (`1856857af`) changes the eXist Home log line from `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown")` back to `System.getProperty("exist.home", "unknown")`. This strongly suggests the wrong accessor had been used at some point, so I ran `git log -p --follow` on `JettyStart.java` and grepped for `exist.home` occurrences across its history to find where the accessor was switched.

**(2) The introducing change:** Commit `c342cbc05e44f776f0055b8182abbf4550a6c459` ("Tue Apr 19 20:15:34 2011", Adam Retter) refactored the version/build/home logging block. It replaced an ad-hoc `Properties` file loader with the new `SystemProperties` helper class, and while doing so it *also* changed the "eXist Home" line from:
```java
msg = "[eXist Home : " + System.getProperty("exist.home") + "]";
```
to:
```java
msg = "[eXist Home : " + SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown") + "]";
```
This was likely a copy-paste mistake made while converting the neighboring `product-version`/`product-build` lines to use the new helper — `exist.home` is a JVM runtime system property (set via `-Dexist.home`), not a build-time value baked into a resource file, so it should never have been routed through `SystemProperties`.

**(3) Supporting evidence:** `src/org/exist/SystemProperties.java` loads its data exclusively from the bundled classpath resource `org/exist/system.properties`, which only contains build-time placeholders (`vendor`, `product-version`, `product-semver`, `product-build`, `git-commit`, etc.) — there is no `exist.home` key in that file. Consequently, since commit `c342cbc05`, the "eXist Home" log line would always print `"unknown"` instead of the actual home directory, which is exactly the bug that `1856857af` fixes by reverting to `System.getProperty("exist.home", "unknown")`.

I'm confident in this identification — the fix commit's diff is essentially the mirror image of `c342cbc05`'s change to the same line, and the `SystemProperties` class's implementation independently confirms why the bug manifested.
